headline: Anthropic adds ID and face checks for Fable 5
body: A quiet day. An updated Anthropic privacy policy now allows collecting government ID and facial data to verify some Fable 5 users, a nudge to Surveillance that lifts 1984. New York City schools froze tech purchases amid AI backlash, nudging Reversion. Horizon Balance: +1.80.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Reversion +0.09, from the NYC schools freeze (+0.07) and fading earlier news (+0.02); 1984 +0.08, from Anthropic's ID checks (+0.07) and fading earlier news (+0.01).
